about: The accent color's check (B20), run by backend/tests/test_company_settings.py and frontend/src/company/accent.test.ts. Accepted colors give how each is kept. Refused ones give which message: format is not # and six hex digits, light is under 4.5:1 against white. The messages are here too, so the page needn't write a color into its code.

messages.format: Enter a color as # and six hex digits, such as #0E6B6B
messages.light: Too light to read on white. Choose a darker color
